rationale: RTS-FRZ-000004 through 000006 are completed. Since the previous assessment, RTS now contains a privacy-safe three-bundle governed outcome corpus, deterministic baseline/candidate regression fixtures, immutable acceptance thresholds, an immutable rollback snapshot, and a fail-closed local verification path. The stale RTS-Skills verification-runner locator has been replaced in Asset Manifest v2 by the canonical RTS outcome verifier, while the current RTS-Skills promotion-review manifest is retained as a pinned reference-only contract. A proposal-only v1 can now be built without granting Skill mutation, adjacent-repository write, self-approval, or external-execution authority.

queries: governed outcome verification corpus evidence classification
baseline candidate deterministic regression rollback snapshot
skill promotion review human approval retirement

assets.notes: Provides three reconstructable SIMULATED_ONLY outcome bundles, exact classification rules, evidence hash verification, privacy checks, and permanent NOT_ELIGIBLE promotion boundary.
Provides pinned baseline/candidate snapshots, six deterministic fixtures, immutable thresholds, zero-regression result verification, and an immutable rollback snapshot.
Provides bounded local execution state, budget, checkpoint and execution_record semantics for proposal-only evaluation inputs.
Retains proposal-only evolution and explicit human adoption authority.
Requires evidence linkage and separates unverified success from repeatable patterns.
Current inspected declarative promotion-review contract; reference-only and not implementation authority.
Defines repeated-evaluation, rollback/retirement, evidence-state and governance-approval expectations.
Refreshes the stale verification-runner reference and records current canonical outcome verification and regression assets.

gaps: All currently committed outcome bundles are SIMULATED_ONLY and cannot establish external business or user success.
The first implementation must remain proposal-only and must not write to RTS-Skills or any adjacent repository.
Human approval, Implementation Preflight, and build authority are still absent and must remain separate gates.
The RTS-Skills promotion-review manifest is minimal and relies on RTS-side evidence, regression, rollback, and decision enforcement.

risks: Synthetic evidence could be overgeneralized beyond the exact bounded local claim.
A learning proposal could accidentally be treated as promotion authority.
Threshold or rollback checks could be weakened by future schema drift.
Private prompts, credentials, customer data, provider payloads, or repository bodies could leak into learning records.
Adjacent-repository mutation could bypass the human decision boundary.
